Hawaii Vacation Packing List

Based on your itinerary from June 10-20, 2024:

Essential Items:
- Swimwear (for beach days at Waikiki and Kailua Beach)
- Sunscreen (high SPF for tropical sun)
- Hiking gear (for Diamond Head hike on June 13)
- Casual outfits (for daily activities and luau)
- Camera (to capture memories)
- Travel documents (passport/ID, hotel confirmations, etc.)

Additional Recommended Items:
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Light rain jacket (for possible showers)
- Hat and sunglasses
- Reusable water bottle
- Snorkeling gear (or plan to rent at Hanauma Bay)
- Formal attire (optional for nice dinners)
- Beach towel
- Insect repellent
- First aid kit
- Chargers and adapters
- Cash and credit cards

Special Notes:
- June 13: Diamond Head hike requires sturdy footwear and water
- June 16: Luau may call for slightly nicer casual attire
- Hotel spa day on June 17: don't forget swimwear and flip-flops
